memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: review of insomnia and low mood.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Mr X reports difficulty falling asleep, waking 2-3 times nightly, and feeling low‑energy for the past 3 months. He denies suicidal thoughts.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/78 mmHg, weight 78 kg, height 1.70 m → BMI 27.0 (obese). Cardiovascular and respiratory exams normal.
IMPRESSION: Insomnia, moderate severity; depressive symptoms, mild‑moderate. TSH and haemoglobin pending.
ARRANGEMENTS: Start melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS, sertraline 50 mg OD. Advise sleep hygiene, limit caffeine after 4 pm, daily walk 30 min. Return if worsening sadness, thoughts of self‑harm, chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: follow‑up on sleep and mood after starting meds.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports sleep onset improved, now falls asleep within 30 min, but still wakes once early morning. Mood feels better, PHQ‑9 score 8.
EXAMINATION: BP 126/80 mmHg, weight 77.5 kg, BMI 26.8 (overweight). No focal deficits.
IMPRESSION: Insomnia improving; depressive symptoms mild. TSH normal, haemoglobin stable.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase sertraline to 75 mg OD, continue melatonin and trazodone. Reinforce activity, weight goal <75 kg. Return if worsening insomnia, new anxiety, palpitations, fever >39°C, or bleeding.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: routine review of insomnia and depression.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports sleeping 6‑7 hours, waking once, feeling rested. Mood stable, denies anhedonia.
EXAMINATION: BP 124/78 mmHg, weight 76.8 kg, BMI 26.5 (overweight).
IMPRESSION: Insomnia mild; depressive symptoms in remission. Labs show normal TSH, Hb, B12.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current meds. Discuss weight‑reducing diet, aim 150 min aerobic weekly. Return if new snoring, witnessed apnoea, worsening low mood, suicidal ideas, chest pain, or fever >39°C.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: review after lipid and glucose results.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient notes occasional daytime fatigue, otherwise sleep adequate. Concern about rising cholesterol.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/80 mmHg, weight 76.0 kg, BMI 26.3 (overweight).
IMPRESSION: Borderline high cholesterol, impaired fasting glucose; insomnia and depression stable.
ARRANGEMENTS: Add atorvastatin 10 mg OD at night. Reinforce low‑saturated‑fat diet, increase fibre, repeat lipid in 3 months. Return if muscle pain, dark urine, severe headache, or fever >39°C.

memories.text:
Reason for visit: routine check‑up.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient feels well, sleeps 6‑7 hours, mood good, no side‑effects from statin.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/78 mmHg, weight 75.2 kg, BMI 25.9 (overweight).
IMPRESSION: Statin tolerated, lipids improved. Insomnia mild, depression in remission.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current regimen. Encourage Mediterranean diet, aim weight <73 kg. Return if new dyspnoea, chest pain, unexplained weakness, fever >39°C, or bleeding.

Reason for visit: follow‑up after appointment change.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports occasional early‑morning awakening, feels rested. Mood stable, denies anxiety.
EXAMINATION: BP 126/78 mmHg, weight 74.8 kg, BMI 25.8 (overweight).
IMPRESSION: Insomnia occasional; depression stable. Labs within target.
ARRANGEMENTS: Consider tapering trazodone to 25 mg HS if night waking persists; otherwise continue. Review sleep hygiene. Return if worsening insomnia, new depressive thoughts, chest pain, palpitations, fever >39°C, or bleeding.
